reviews.text:
I give this hotel a three star rating. Personally, the experience was below 1 star. But bed bugs is a problem that a hotel can't do so much about. Or can it..?

In any case, this was the first hotel that I stayed in Hanoi. The staff is nice, they offer a breakfast and the room looked quite nice. It is big and had a double bed and a smaller bed. Fortunately I put my bags as always as far away from the big bed as possible, on a chair/on the small bed. In fact, so nice that I decided to stay another night. The second night I stayed awake until 2am and was surfing on my phone. I got a bit itchy, so I turned on the lights. Background: I have been traveling for nearly 6 months, and seen two bed bugs so far. Last time many months ago, and before this hotel I stayed in a really good quality place in BKK for almost two weeks without any problems.

Well, I see not only one bed bug, but two. I took the pillow up and found a couple more, ripped the sheets up and found even more. In different sizes. I took pics as proof and immediately checked out at 2am. Had to struggle not having to pay for the whole night, but I told the (nice) staff that his boss can come to the hotel to negotiate with me, otherwise I'm out. Anyway, I had a rough time finding a place, but found one after 3am..

As I already mentioned, it might not be the hotel's fault (unless they are aware of the problem). After some googling, I guess they should be aware of it, since the different sizes of the bed bugs means that they have most likely been nesting there for a while and even laid eggs some time ago.

Btw, I have not seen a single bed bug since I left the place (more than 2 weeks ago).

Khách sạn nhỏ xinh, hơi khó tìm, nhưng bạn có thể hỏi đường. Lễ tân thân thiện, phòng sáng sủa, sạch sẽ, yên tĩnh và thậm chí còn có ban công. Bữa sáng khá khiêm tốn. So với các chỗ nghỉ khác ở Hà Nội, đây là một khách sạn rất tốt.

Nhân viên rất tốt, thân thiện và nhiệt tình, phòng rất sạch sẽ và đẹp.
Khách sạn nằm ở khu phố cổ và trung tâm Hà Nội.
Bữa sáng rất ngon, phục vụ tuyệt vời, vị trí thuận lợi. Trên hết, rất sạch sẽ.
